breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still uses the thin-walled closed tube (shear flow) approach to compute the maximum shear stress (steps 1–4: computing mean radius, mean enclosed area, shear flow q = T/(2Aₘ), and τmax = q/t). The ground truth requires using only the exact thick-walled torsion formula τmax = T·(do/2)/J throughout. The agent repeated the incorrect thin-walled approximation rather than discarding it in favor of the standard hollow shaft torsion relation.
